title: Positivity of the Hedge potential
statement:
Fix a learning rate $\eta \in \bbr$, a loss sequence $\ell$ for $N \ge 1$ experts over $T$ rounds, and a time $t$. Then the potential at time $t$ is strictly positive:
\[
  W_t \;=\; \sum_{i=1}^{N} \exp\!\bigl(-\eta \cdot L_t(i)\bigr) \;>\; 0,
\]
where $L_t(i) = \sum_{s < t} \ell_s(i)$ is the cumulative loss of expert $i$ through the first $t$ rounds.
replaced: For any $\eta$, loss sequence $\ell$, and time $t$, the potential $W_t > 0$.
